description: Source code for Odoo (OpenERP) module defining analytic account models, journals, and related methods.

classes.name: account_analytic_account
classes.description: Model for managing analytic accounts with methods for calculating balances, credits, debits, quantities, and name representations.

classes.name: account_analytic_journal
classes.description: Model for analytic journals, including name, code, type, and associated lines.

classes.name: account_journal
classes.description: Inherited model extending 'account.journal' with a link to an analytic journal.

methods.name: _credit_calc
methods.description: Calculates total credit (negative amounts) for analytic accounts within a date range.

methods.name: _debit_calc
methods.description: Calculates total debit (positive amounts) for analytic accounts within a date range.

methods.name: _balance_calc
methods.description: Calculates the balance of analytic accounts, including child accounts, with currency conversion.

methods.name: _quantity_calc
methods.description: Calculates total quantity for analytic accounts, including child accounts.

methods.name: name_get
methods.description: Returns display names for analytic accounts, including parent account hierarchy.

methods.name: _complete_name_calc
methods.description: Returns full account name with hierarchy.

methods.name: _get_company_currency
methods.description: Retrieves the currency of the associated company.

methods.name: check_recursion
methods.description: Checks for recursive parent-child relationships in analytic accounts.

methods.name: create
methods.description: Creates a new analytic account, assigning a sequence code if not provided.

methods.name: copy
methods.description: Duplicates an analytic account, resetting code and lines.

methods.name: on_change_parent
methods.description: Updates account code and partner when parent account changes.

methods.name: name_search
methods.description: Searches for accounts by code or name, including hierarchical search.
